title: Fast Approximate Bayesian Inference through Bayesian Optimization Sequential Surrogate (BOSS)
text: basic example shows solve simple problem 1-D. Assume true (log) marginal likelihood given following sinusoidal function: can use boss function approximate (log) marginal likelihood function, specifying objective function, dimension problem, bounds BO optimization. alpha parameter controls level essential support, h controls target fill-distance design points.  advanced applications, user can also manually perform step BOSS algorithm, shown :
code: library(BOSS) f1d <- function(x) sin(0.5*pi*x) # A automatic implementation br2 <- boss(f1d, D = 1,              modal_opts = list(lower = 0, upper = 2),             alpha = 0.05, h = 0.1, verbose = 1) #> Stage 1: Bayesian Optimization via Mode-Seeking Surrogate (BOSS) started. #> Stage 1: BOSS finished. #> Total time taken: 1.76 seconds. #> Start updating Hessian at the mode... #> Hessian updated in  0  seconds. #> Stage 2: Fill-in to target spacing h =  0.1  #> fill in: added 16 point(s). #> Final update completed in  0.01  seconds. plot(br2) # A manual implementation br <- BOSS:::BOSS_modal(func = f1d, D = 1,                         lower = 0, upper = 2,                         update_step = 5,                         max_iter = 20,                         verbose = 1) #> Stage 1: Bayesian Optimization via Mode-Seeking Surrogate (BOSS) started. #> Stage 1: BOSS finished. #> Total time taken: 0.82 seconds. br <- update_hessian(br) br <- compute_essential_support(br, alpha=0.05) br <- construct_essential_designs(br) br <- compute_fill_in(br) br <- fill_in(br, h = 0.1, verbose = 1, max_add = 100) #> fill in: added 17 point(s). br_update <- update_boss(br) plot(br_update)

func function f: [0,1]^D -> R optimize. update_step Integer; often refit GP hyperparameters. max_iter Maximum number BO iterations. D Input dimension. quad Logical; FALSE (default), use zero-mean GP model. TRUE, fit linear-plus-quadratic mean model \( eta_0 + x^	op  eta_1 + (x \otimes x)^	op  eta_2\) alongside GP. lower Numeric vector length D giving lower bounds (original scale). upper Numeric vector length D giving upper bounds. nu GP covariance smoothness. \(
u = \infty\) represents squared-exponential kernel; \(0 < 
u < \infty\) represents Matern kernel smoothness \(\lceil
uceil - 1\). noise_var GP observation noise variance. modal_iter_check often (iterations) check convergence via modal criteria. modal_check_warmup Minimum iter starting modal checks. modal_k.nn Number nearest neighbours use modal criterion. modal_eps Convergence threshold modal criterion. initial_design Number initial points sample. delta Exploration parameter passed UCB. optim.n Number multistart acquisition optimization. optim.max.iter Maxit length-scale optimization. opt.lengthscale.grid Optional grid size length-scale search. opt.grid Optional grid size acquisition search. verbose Verbosity level (0–3).

what: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
title: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
text: Evaluate (negative) log-likelihood observed data Gaussian Process model, optionally including linear-plus-quadratic mean function.

title: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
code: compute_like(   length_scale,   x,   y,   signal_var,   noise_var,   D,   quad = FALSE,   nu = Inf )

title: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
text: length_scale Positive numeric scalar vector length-scales dimension. x Numeric vector matrix training inputs (rows = observations). y Numeric vector training responses. signal_var Positive numeric scalar specifying GP signal variance (\(\sigma^2\)). noise_var Positive numeric scalar specifying observation noise variance. D Integer. Dimensionality input space (number columns x). quad Logical; FALSE (default), assume zero-mean GP. TRUE, include mean function \(\beta_0 + x^\top \beta_1 + (x \otimes x)^\top \beta_2\). nu Positive numeric specifying smoothness parameter Matérn kernel. Defaults Inf, selecting Squared Exponential kernel.

title: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
text: numeric scalar giving negative log-likelihood (additive constant).   Extremely large values (\(>1e^{20}\)) returned computation produces NaN, NA,   infinite results.

title: Compute Gaussian Process Log-Likelihood (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — compute_like
text: **Zero-mean GP** (quad = FALSE): * Build covariance \(C = K_{xx} + \sigma_n^2 \) via   cov_generator. * Compute Cholesky factor \(L L^T = C\). * Log-determinant: \(\log\det(C) = 2\sum\log(\mathrm{diag}(L))\). * Precision \(Q = C^{-1} = \texttt{chol2inv}(L)\). * Negative log-likelihood:   $$\frac{1}{2}\,y^T Q\,y \;-\; \log\det(Q) \;-\;\sum \log\bigl[\text{LogNormal}(length\_scale\mid prior\_l)\bigr]$$ **GP quadratic mean** (quad = TRUE): * Construct design matrix \(X = [1,\,x,\,\mathrm{unique}(x \otimes x)]\). * Build \(C = K_{xx} + \sigma^2_n \) precision \(Q\). * Form marginal precision \(S = X^\top Q X\) invert via Cholesky. * Compute two quadratic terms:   \(\tfrac12\,y^\top Q\,y\) \(\tfrac12\,y^\top Q X S^{-1} X^\top Q\,y\). * Combine log-determinants \(Q\) \(S^{-1}\) log-prior   yield final negative log-likelihood.

what: Approximately fill-in by supplying a Sobol-sequence in the essential support and filter against existing design points. — fill_in
title: Approximately fill-in by supplying a Sobol-sequence in the essential support and filter against existing design points. — fill_in
text: 1. Based required fill-distance h, compute required number quasi-uniform design points    \(n = {n_sample_max, 2*Vol(Original box)/h^D}\). 2. Generate Sobol-sequence within original box. 3. Truncate Sobol-sequence within ellipsoid. 4. Compute distance existing design points Sobol-sequence remove Sobol-candidates within h existing points. 5. Add maximum max_add number selected fill-Sobol-candidates ensure optimal covering ellipsoid. 6. Recompute new fill-based selected Sobol existing design points.

title: Gaussian Process Prediction (with Optional Quadratic Mean) — predict_gp
text: zero-mean case (quad = FALSE), function: Constructs \(K_{oo}, K_{op}, K_{pp}\) via choice_cov. Adds noise_var diagonal \(K_{oo}\) computes     Cholesky factor L. Computes conditional mean \(K_{op} L^{-T} L^{-1} y\)     covariance \(K_{pp} - K_{op} L^{-T} L^{-1} K_{op}^T\). quad = TRUE, design matrix intercept, linear, unique quadratic terms built observed prediction inputs, coefficients \(\beta\) estimated via generalized least squares. posterior mean covariance combine mean model GP residuals.
